messages:
Maya (Product): quick kickoff — we need to align on the observability roadmap for Q3: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and error analytics. customer asks piled up, so we need hard tradeoffs.
Alex (Eng-Platform): agree. can we list must-haves vs nice-to-haves? perf overhead is a big gating factor.
Priya (Eng-Observability): must-haves from infra POV: 1) per-route latency p50/p95/p99, 2) per-model token cost breakdown, 3) trace hooks that don't add >5% p95.
Casey (PM): customer asks: two large customers want per-request cost tags and sampling control for traces, both for Dedicated and Private. they said release readiness depends on that.
Jordan (Eng-ML): for per-token cost we need KV cache visibility + batch attribution. that's an implementation effort across runtime and console. estimate ~3 sprint work.
Nina (Design): dashboards should ship with three starter views: overview (SLOs + costs), queryable traces, and error heatmap. low visual complexity to start.
Maya (Product): launch criteria proposal: 1) dashboard templates (overview + latency + cost) 2) trace hook with sampling config and minimal baggage 3) alerting for error rate regressions 4) perf overhead validated <5% on a 3-model mix. thoughts?
Alex (Eng-Platform): sounds reasonable. add rollout policy: start hosted beta -> Dedicated customers opt-in -> Private GA. That reduces blast radius.
Priya (Eng-Observability): technical note: trace hook API: 
```
POST /v1/trace-hooks {
  sample_rate: 0.1,
  include_prefixes: ["/v1/chat", "/v1/embed"],
  tags: ["model","route","customer_id"]
}
```
This keeps payload small. sample_rate must be configurable per-customer.
Casey (PM): customers also asked for cost breakdown by model variant and quantization level. add as stretch goal.
Jordan (Eng-ML): quantization-level cost attribution is doable if runtime emits model_variant metadata on request. minor runtime change + console mapping. estimate 1 sprint for telemetry, 1 sprint for console.
Maya (Product): OK. prioritize per-request cost tags and sampling control as MVP. quantization/variant cost as M1.
Nina (Design): quick UX question: do we show cost as absolute $$ or normalized token-cost units? customers requested both.
Alex (Eng-Platform): show both. $$ requires billing linkups (edge case for Private). token-cost units are safer for Private.
Priya (Eng-Observability): data retention: default 30 days for traces, 90 days for metrics. Private customers may request longer via config. note: retention affects storage costs a lot.
Maya (Product): acceptance criteria checklist for launch:
- Dashboard templates exist and are editable
- Trace hook API implemented and docs + examples
- Per-request cost tags emitted and visible in UI
- Error analytics: grouping + root-cause drilldowns (basic)
- Performance overhead tests + signoff
- Rollout plan documented
Can someone own the list items?
Alex (Eng-Platform): I'll own runtime + perf tests.
Priya (Eng-Observability): I'll own trace hook API + storage plan.
Casey (PM): I'll coordinate docs + customer comms + beta signups.
Nina (Design): I'll prototype dashboard templates by EOW and hand off to frontend.
Jordan (Eng-ML): I'll add model_variant metadata and batching attribution hooks.
Maya (Product): timeline proposal: 6 weeks for MVP (two sprints). if we scope down further to hit 4 weeks we drop the error RCA and quantization-cost mapping. prefer to commit 6 weeks.
Alex (Eng-Platform): 6 weeks is tight but doable with focused scope. need two dedicated engs full-time.
Priya (Eng-Observability): risk: Private installs with strict network constraints may need an offline metrics shipper. that's a +2 week unknown.
Casey (PM): mitigation: document Private constraints and offer a 'limited feature' compatibility matrix for GA.
Maya (Product): decision: go for 6-week MVP, prioritize per-request cost, sampling control, and dashboard templates. RCA and quantization-cost = M1.
Nina (Design): noted. I'll mock templates for beta flows and include a compact mobile view.
infra-bot: deploy-bot noted: created epic OBS-4321 and linked PR template.
Maya (Product): next steps: Alex & Priya to write tech spec by Tues, Casey to start customer beta invites, Nina to upload mocks. we'll sync Thurs 10am.
Alex (Eng-Platform): will do. tagging @Priya for spec sync.
Priya (Eng-Observability): on it. adding perf test matrix to the spec.
Casey (PM): adding two customer contacts to beta list: AcmeAI and FinLedger. both require Dedicated support.
Jordan (Eng-ML): quick question: do we need to expose sampling controls to customers via API or console only?
Maya (Product): both. console control for beta, API control by GA.
Alex (Eng-Platform): note: exposes an admin API + RBAC checks. add to spec.
Maya (Product): awesome. thanks everyone — see you Thu 10am. :tada:
